landings.contentHtml:
Keeping a Dubai licence current from Switzerland

Swiss companies, family offices and advisers use Dubai for trading, commodities, wealth structures and Gulf client work. Documentation quality matters to Swiss banks and advisers, so a clear paper trail is part of the setup. Many owners then manage the company from Switzerland and need the licence renewed on time without a trip to Dubai. The general process is explained in our guide to trade licence renewal and amendments; this page covers what changes when the owner is in Switzerland.

What has to happen in order

The tenancy registration (Ejari) must be valid first, then the renewal is submitted with the owner's approval, and the fees are paid. If a partner or manager changes, the memorandum is amended and notarised before the licence is updated (MOA drafting and amendments).

Home-country points that affect this service

  • Transfers from Swiss banks to the UAE are international payments in francs or dollars. Banks ask for the source of funds and the purpose, so keep supporting documents ready.
  • Swiss residents declare worldwide income and assets under cantonal and federal rules, and the treatment of a Dubai company depends on where it is managed. Switzerland and the UAE have a double tax agreement. Ask a Swiss tax adviser before you set the structure.
  • Swiss documents are apostilled by the cantonal chancellery for cantonal documents and by the Federal Chancellery for federal ones, and need a certified translation for UAE use.

Documents and information to prepare

  • The current trade licence and the registered tenancy contract
  • Passport and Emirates ID copies of the owners and manager
  • A power of attorney or authorisation letter signed in Switzerland and attested for UAE use, if you cannot approve online
  • Any approval the activity needs from another authority
  • For a partner change: the new partner's documents and the signed amendment

How it works from Switzerland

  1. Check the expiry dates of the licence and the tenancy registration, and renew the tenancy if needed.
  2. Approve the renewal online or through a power of attorney signed in Switzerland.
  3. We submit the renewal, pay the fees and collect the new licence.
  4. We update labour, insurance and bank records and set the next reminder.

Currency and payments

The dirham is pegged to the US dollar, so the franc-dirham rate follows the franc-dollar market. Swiss owners often hold dollars for UAE costs to avoid repeated conversions.
